_note: Default fit per garment type for the avatar pack (MVP-03). Every garment size is derived from the wearer's own tape measurements plus the ease and proportions below, so no real-item flat measurements are needed. Changing a value is a reviewed edit: rebuild and run the checks. All lengths in cm unless a name says 'fraction'.
_colour_note: Neutral light grey, sRGB 0-255. The app sets the colour (MVP-06); a light base multiplies cleanly if the app tints the material instead of replacing it.

tee._necklines_note: Other necklines (V1.1-04), the same shell cut differently. Depths decided by Joe on 15 Nov 2026: V 12 cm and scoop 9 cm below the shoulder-top line, against the crew neck's 6 cm. width_factor scales the crew neck's width.

sweatshirt._note: Regular-fit crew-neck sweatshirt (MVP-07), an alternative top over the trousers. More chest ease than the tee, long sleeves, hem and cuffs drawn in as ribbing would (hem gap measured from the trousers, cuff gap from the wrist). The hem and cuffs are placed by the body (hem above the crotch, cuff short of the wrist joint) rather than by a length, so they sit the same way on every body.

trousers._note: Regular-fit straight trousers, hem just above the floor.

shorts._note: Shorts (V1.1-05): the trouser template with the trousers' ease, cut at a shorter inseam. Length decided by Joe on 15 Nov 2026: above the knee, 23 cm inseam (crotch to hem, the same for every body). The leg opening is the trousers' circumference at that height plus leg_opening_extra_cm, let out over the bottom flare_band_cm only, so above the band the shorts are the trousers' shell and the tops keep their clearance.

bust._note: V2-08: how a top sits over the bust on a female body (sex_base female; male bodies never read this, so their garments are unchanged). The offset shell rested on the body at every bump, so the tops came to a point at each breast and tucked under the bust. hang: below each bust apex, down to hang_reach_cm (the floor falls away over the bottom third, so the hang ends in a slope), the cloth is kept no further back than the cloth above it (less hang_slack_cm_per_cm of drop), so it falls from the bust the way a worn top does; hang_halfwidth_cm is how far sideways a vertex looks for the cloth above it (at least the mesh spacing, or the chain breaks and the cloth sags back), and beyond the apex the floor tapers back by hang_side_taper_cm_per_cm so the hung cloth stops at the side of the breast instead of spreading under the arm. pad: within pad_radius_cm of each apex the clearance to the body rises from the usual 3 mm to 3 mm plus pad_cm, rounding the apex the way a bra cup does. Measured by pack/bust_shape.py against spike/tolerances.json bust_shape. tee_trousers_gap_cm (V2-09): the clearance the hung tee is rebuilt with over the trousers (it was 0.4 cm; a smaller bust calibrated the tee to a smaller ease and the back of the tee then met the waistband, so it is 0.6 cm).

tights._note: Tights (V2-04): the trouser template as a skin-close shell, from the trousers' waist line to a hem above the floor. Worn under shorts (and skirts in v3), never under trousers. gap_cm is the distance from the skin; the hard checks need at least 0.2 cm, so 0.25 leaves a little for the cut edges. hem_above_floor_cm ends the tights at the ankle, because feet are bare until shoes arrive in v5. smooth_iterations is how often the shell is smoothed (the trousers use 25 so they drape; a skin-close shell needs few, or the ankle bulges towards the foot). waist_below_trousers_cm ends the tights just under the shorts' waistband, so the two top edges are not level (they crossed there). Opaque or sheer is a display setting in the app, not a different mesh.

skirt._note: V3-01b: the A-line midi skirt, women's bodies only, draped once at asset time with Blender's cloth solver (spike/cloth/skirt_cloth.py, V3-00 and V3-01a) and shipped as a fixed mesh on that person's own body; there are no blended sizes. Pattern: ease at the waistband and over the hip, hem circumference as a multiple of the skirt's hip, hem height as a fraction of body height (mid-calf). Cloth: Blender's cloth with the waistband pinned, the body as the collider, gravity eased in over gravity_ramp_frames (frames in all). Chosen, not calibrated; the values are those that passed on B and the small and large synthetic women in V3-01a. Tops: Joe's decision of 17 Nov 2026 is that a top is tucked in, so every tee is cut flat tuck_gap_cm above the skirt's top edge, and where the cut hem is wider than the skirt's top ring it is drawn in to tuck_in_cm inside the ring, easing out over tuck_band_cm.
